Reminders about pet comfort at the skyport
The desk wrote this for people travelling soon

Pet comfort guidance at Aurelia Skyways

This note gives practical guidance for the Companion Animal Travel Desk and is meant to help you prepare calmly. Trained staff review each animal's comfort needs and record any service changes in the desk ledger. Every animal receives patient attention, and the welfare coordinator checks that the arrangements match the journey.

Please keep your animal settled in a secure carrier or other approved travel arrangement. The carrier should allow safe standing, turning, and resting where permitted. Offer familiar bedding and a clean lining, and avoid adding loose items that could shift in transit. A calm feeding routine before arrival at the skyport may also help your animal remain relaxed.

If your animal is a reptile, <<FACT F078>> Please bring any requested documents and arrive with enough margin to complete check-in without hurry. Staff will review the handling plan and note anything that may help with comfort during the journey.

If your animal is a rabbit, <<FACT F058>> Keep the animal sheltered from noise, sudden movement, and unnecessary handling while you move through the skyport. Handlers will treat each animal carefully and will follow the recorded instructions on the file.

If you notice stress, unusual breathing, or signs of discomfort, tell the desk at once so a staff member can respond. For further help, please contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways before you travel.
